email_body:
Hello,

This is a speculative enquiry rather than a reply to a dated advert. Your graduates page lists civil engineering graduates and cadets and invites a CV and cover letter at this address, so I am registering my interest in a graduate civil or civil cadet role in Melbourne.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in Civil 3D and AutoCAD. From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as a field engineer and project-in-charge, including residential subdivision finishing works. I am based in Melton VIC, hold a White Card, a licence and my own transport, and have full working rights to December 2027 on a 485 visa. I am available for site and regional work.

Building and maintaining safer civil infrastructure for local communities is the work I want to grow in. My Australian design work so far is from study, so I would start at graduate or cadet level.

I've attached my resume and cover letter. Could you keep me in mind for a graduate civil or civil cadet opening?

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
macdarenz@gmail.com
https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio

paragraphs: I would like to register my interest in a graduate civil engineer or civil cadet role. This is a speculative enquiry rather than a reply to a dated advert. Your graduates page lists civil engineering graduates and cadets among entry pathways and invites a CV and cover letter at apply@citywide.com.au.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at Albright Institute. I designed and documented road geometry, earthworks, pavement systems and stormwater drainage, prepared and reviewed drawings in AutoCAD and Civil 3D to Australian Standards, and lodged Before You Dig Australia enquiries. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering (2019). Safer civil infrastructure for the communities you serve is the work I want to learn.

From April 2019 to February 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines. As project-in-charge I reviewed drawings and carried out inspections, safety checks and quality monitoring. As a field engineer on residential subdivision finishing works I helped with site inspections and quality checks and prepared site reports, material records and progress reports. My Australian design work so far is from study, so I would start at graduate or cadet level.

I live in Melton, so your North Melbourne head office and Melbourne metro sites are within reach. I hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and my own transport, and have full working rights to December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa.
I've attached my resume and would be glad to talk about a graduate civil or civil cadet opening.
